project_role: bounded research-prototype development; not deployment validation
objective: Test whether limiting repeated-group influence and adding deterministic traffic-rate and directionality features improves cross-domain intrusion-detection robustness over a matched group-capped linear reference.
hypothesis: Group-capped source fitting will reduce dependence on a few massive repeated groups, and deterministic derived traffic features will improve leave-one-dataset-out MCC and balanced accuracy without producing the near-universal attack predictions observed in Version 2.

observed_group_concentration_examples: NF-CSE-CIC-IDS2018 training used 299372 rows from only 13 complete groups
NF-ToN-IoT calibration used 105627 rows from 111 complete groups
NF-BoT-IoT training used 330348 rows from 602 complete groups
v2_motivation.interpretation: Version 2 showed that domain/family row weighting and ordinary model regularisation were insufficient. Version 3 changes the development representation and group influence rather than performing another broad hyperparameter search.

development_status.claim_boundary: The four domains are source-aware development evidence only. None is an untouched test or independent confirmation dataset.

independent_confirmation_boundary.requirement: Any final confirmation requires a genuinely new dataset or capture that has not been inspected, scored, audited, or used during Versions 1 through 3.
independent_confirmation_boundary.fallback_if_unavailable: Report the selected design, if any, as a development-only research prototype and make no deployment-readiness claim.

features.derived_feature_rule: The formulas are fixed and use only the eight registered base fields. Any clipping, imputation, encoding, or scaling parameters are fitted on source-training rows only within each fold.
features.shortcut_rule: Endpoint identifiers and TTL-related fields are prohibited in every Version 3 candidate.

group_and_sampling_protocol.group_definition: Categorical base-feature values exact; numeric base-feature values rounded to five significant digits.
group_and_sampling_protocol.group_hash: SHA-256 of the canonical grouped base-feature tuple, namespaced by dataset.
group_and_sampling_protocol.cross_partition_rule: All rows from one namespaced group remain in one within-domain partition.
group_and_sampling_protocol.within_group_selection: Deterministic hash order, first preserving each available binary-label and raw-attack-label stratum, then filling the remaining group allowance in hash order.
group_and_sampling_protocol.group_selection: Deterministic round-robin across source dataset and raw attack family. Capacity is charged using the retained capped contribution, never the original complete-group row count.
group_and_sampling_protocol.held_out_domain_evaluation: Score every row of the held-out domain in chunks. Do not apply the 64-row group cap to evaluation rows.
group_and_sampling_protocol.row_weights: No additional domain/family sample weighting. The sampling design limits row dominance; model class weighting is fixed per candidate.
required_sampling_diagnostics: selected rows and distinct groups by domain and partition
retained rows by class and raw attack label
largest retained share contributed by one group
zero group overlap among training, calibration, and held-out partitions

threshold_rule.scope: calibration portions of the three source domains only
threshold_rule.selection: Among feasible thresholds, maximise the minimum source-domain MCC; break ties by higher mean source-domain MCC, higher minimum supported-stratum recall, lower maximum source-domain false-positive rate, then higher threshold.
threshold_rule.no_feasible_threshold: Use the same ranking without feasibility, mark the fold constraint_failed, and prevent that candidate from passing the promotion gate.

evaluation_metrics.group_balanced_definition: Within each held-out domain, every exact evaluation group receives equal total weight; rows inside a group divide that group's weight equally.
subgroup_reporting: every raw attack label with its support
evaluation_metrics.uncertainty: For the matched reference and any promotion-eligible candidate, compute paired 95% bootstrap intervals over exact evaluation groups within each held-out domain using 200 replicates and seed 42.

eligibility_requirements: source-calibration threshold constraints pass in all four folds
row-weighted held-out balanced accuracy is greater than 0.50 in every domain
row-weighted held-out false-positive rate is at most 0.25 in every domain
row-weighted held-out recall is at least 0.20 for every attack/domain stratum with at least 100 rows
group-balanced held-out MCC is greater than 0 in every domain
improvement_requirements: macro-average row-weighted held-out MCC exceeds the matched reference by at least 0.03
worst-domain row-weighted balanced accuracy exceeds the matched reference by at least 0.02
maximum row-weighted held-out false-positive rate is no more than 0.02 above the matched reference
promotion_rule.ranking: Among candidates meeting every requirement, select the highest macro-average row-weighted MCC; break ties by higher worst-domain balanced accuracy, higher minimum supported-attack recall, higher worst-domain group-balanced MCC, lower maximum false-positive rate, then candidate ID alphabetically.
promotion_rule.failure_outcome: If no candidate satisfies every requirement, record 'no Version 3 candidate selected' and do not weaken the rule after viewing results.
promotion_rule.claim_boundary: Passing means development-promising research prototype only; it does not establish independent generalisation or real-world deployment readiness.

overfitting_checks: training-to-calibration and calibration-to-held-out gaps for MCC, balanced accuracy, recall, and false-positive rate
per-domain and per-attack recall rather than aggregate accuracy alone
score separation and predicted-positive rate in every domain
performance by original group-size bucket and mixed-label status
sampling concentration before and after the 64-row cap
Random Forest out-of-bag score where available

allowed: implement and test the registered Version 3 runner
verify the locked Version 2 evidence and existing local dataset files
construct the registered group partitions and capped source samples
fit only the three registered candidates
select thresholds only from registered source-calibration rows
score each full held-out development domain once per candidate
report a failed promotion result without changing the rule
prohibited: describe any of the four domains as untouched confirmation or final test data
add candidates, derived features, thresholds, splits, or alternate caps after viewing Version 3 results
use endpoint identifiers or TTL-related shortcut features
fit preprocessing, sampling choices, models, or thresholds using a fold's held-out domain
subsample held-out rows for final fold metrics
make a deployment or real-world readiness claim
silently rerun a failed or completed experiment
integrity_rules.amendment_rule: A necessary implementation correction must be documented and committed before rerunning an affected experiment. A substantive design change requires a new protocol version.

stopping_rule: After implementation and preflight tests pass, run the registered Version 3 experiment once. Stop after the fixed promotion verdict; do not silently retry or expand the search.
interpretation_boundary: Version 3 can test whether group-capped fitting and derived traffic features improve development robustness. It cannot prove that the resulting model is safe or reliable in live networks without genuinely new confirmation data and operational validation.
